title: Assets
subtitle: Every physical asset the tenant owns — one row per kind, click through to the individual assets.

empty.title: No asset kinds yet
empty.message: Asset kinds come from the catalogue. Create one under Pricing, then add assets here.
empty.noUnits: No assets of this kind yet
empty.noUnitsHint: Add the first one and it becomes bookable straight away.

add.title: Add {{name}}
add.subtitle: {{count}} already in the estate
add.identifierNote: Each one gets its own identifier and QR code.
add.kioskHint: Only compartments belong to a kiosk.

edit.title: {{identifier}}
edit.subtitle: Change this one asset without touching the rest of its kind.
edit.statusLocked: Held by a live booking ({{status}}) — finish or reassign it first.
edit.ownPrice: Price this one apart from its kind (kind price: {{price}})

remove.title: Remove {{identifier}}
remove.subtitle: This takes the asset out of the estate.
remove.body: It disappears from availability at once. Past bookings keep their history.

price.title: Price {{name}}
price.subtitle: Applies to all {{count}} assets of this kind
price.baseHint: What the counter charges for one of these.
price.overtimeHint: Leave at zero when overtime does not apply.
price.clearOverrides: Also reset every asset that carries its own price
price.noProduct: This kind is not sold by any product yet, so it has no price. Create a product for it under Pricing first.

qr.title: QR code — {{identifier}}
qr.subtitle: Print it, stick it on the asset. Scanning opens this asset.
qr.couldNotDownload: Could not save the QR code

unit.title: Asset
unit.notFoundHint: The code may belong to another tenant, or the asset has been removed.

toast.appliesToAll: Every asset of this kind follows the new price.
toast.overridesCleared: {{count}} asset(s) put back on the kind price.
toast.kindNoUnits: Add assets to it when you are ready.

free.title: Force {{identifier}} free
free.subtitle: The asset is held by a booking.
free.body: This detaches it from {{ref}} and puts it straight back into availability. Use it when the asset is physically free but the record says otherwise — it is written to the audit trail.
free.bodyNoBooking: This puts it straight back into availability. Use it when the asset is physically free but the record says otherwise — it is written to the audit trail.

newKind.title: New kind of asset
newKind.subtitle: A kind is what the counter sells — "Compartment L", "Single Scooter Bay". The assets themselves come next.
newKind.shapeHint: What the asset physically is. It sets how the kind is priced and reserved.
newKind.nameHint: The name staff and customers see.
newKind.dimensionsHint: Width, height, depth — the packing plan uses these to fit bags.
newKind.bagCountHint: How many typical bags fit in one.
newKind.howManyHint: Each gets its own identifier and QR code. Leave at zero to add them later.

removeKind.title: Delete {{name}}
removeKind.subtitle: Only a kind with no assets left can go.
removeKind.body: The kind disappears from the estate and its product is retired from the counter. Past bookings keep their history.

editKind.title: Rename {{name}}
editKind.subtitle: The product the counter sells is renamed with it.
